name: launchpilot-saas-pass
description: LaunchPilot & SaaS Pass — OpenSpec-driven serverless edge platform (Cloudflare Workers, D1, KV, Vectorize) with a file-backed MDX engineering blog.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @launchpilot/worker && npm run build --workspace @launchpilot/pages
scripts.build:worker: rm -rf apps/worker/dist && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc --outdir apps/worker/dist
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @launchpilot/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace @launchpilot/pages
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspace @launchpilot/worker && npm run clean --workspace @launchpilot/pages
